# Functional Components shows its button and nested-components tiles

## Context

#21140's target lists five tiles for Functional Components: define, host, nested template, and "button and nested components ↻". Three are in the catalog. #21359 renews the two examples so that they read as examples, and its own criteria say "no record and no cover is added". So when #21359 merges, the two examples are ready and still on no page. A row-by-row sweep of the target on 22 Nov found no leaf that adds them.

## The Problem

A visitor who opens Functional Components sees three of the five tiles the group was planned with. The two missing ones are the ones a contributor is repairing for exactly this purpose.

## The Architectural Reality

- `examples/functional/button/base` and `examples/functional/nestedComponents`: no record on `dev` `78013b10fc`.
- A tile is a record with `kind: 'component'` and a crop cover taken through `neomjs/pages`.
- **Blocked by #21359**: the tiles are captured from the renewed examples.

## The Fix

After #21359 has merged: one record each with `kind: 'component'`, a name and caption in the visitor's words, and its crop. One pull request for both.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Functional Components shows five tiles; the two new ones open their examples on the workbench.
- [ ] Each record's caption says what the example proves, in the visitor's words.
- [ ] The catalog's specs pass.
- [ ] The look: the two tile stages at 1440×900 and 390×844, Neo Dark, on the pull request.

**Publication (added 22 Nov, the same for every leaf of this wave).** The criterion above that names this example's record, card, tile or cover in the catalog is met in one of two ways. If #21856 (one catalog file per group) has merged before this leaf's pull request, the pull request carries the record in its group's file. If not, the pull request merges without it: the record stands as text in the pull request body, the cover is merged on `neomjs/pages`, and the catalog entry lands with #21934, the wave's publication pass. Either way this leaf closes with its example.

## Out of Scope

The renewal itself (#21359). `functional/templateComponent`, which the target retires as a twin.
